skill.summary: Operate Lithtrix (lithtrix.ai) from an agent — self-serve API keys, credibility-scored web discovery, page browse, per-agent JSON memory, opt-in commons laye...

latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Lithtrix skill now includes browsing, shared memory, community features, and a credits-based billing model.

- Adds support for full-text page browsing via the new `/v1/browse` endpoint (requires paid pack).
- Introduces "commons" layer — opt-in, cross-agent shared memory entries and search.
- Includes a public community scoreboard for live aggregate platform stats.
- Replaces tiered and referral-based quotas with credits-based billing (trial and paid packs, auto top-up).
- Updates all quickstart, billing, and usage guides to reflect new endpoints, pricing, and capabilities.
- Simplifies usage: registration grants a Spark trial pack; all usage is now credit-metered.
